notes: Sepolia rehearsal, chain id 11155111. Native ETH is currency0 and SVO is currency1. The opening sqrtPriceX96 is 792281625142643375935439503360000: 100,000,000 SVO per ETH, or a 10 ETH opening cap for the fixed 1,000,000,000 supply with 18 decimals. The 12500 (1.25%) pool LP fee is additional to the hook fee. Hook permissions encode 8396 (0x20cc). The factory supplies the PoolManager, freshly deployed token and initializing factory through the flat constructor arguments; it mines CREATE2 and deploys, initializes and seeds initial liquidity atomically. The hook constructor creates its immutable LifeForceVault, discoverable via vault(). No separate vault deployment or configuration is needed. Sells pay 3.5% of actual gross ETH; buys decay linearly from 50% to 3.5% over 3600 seconds. All hook fees go to the vault directly if the manager has enough ETH, otherwise as ERC-6909 claims redeemed permissionlessly by redeemFees(). The vault earmarks 70% for voice AI inference and 30% for manual SVO buybacks, rounding the buyback portion down and giving the remainder to inference. Only REFUEL_SAFE 0xb1eC9d1C36974d05eb9889eBf8A150b05791E559 may withdraw each reserve to itself. The vault never swaps. Anyone may burn its entire SVO balance to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Transfers to DEAD increment totalBurned without reducing totalSupply. There are no holder payouts, owners, setters, pause powers or upgrades. See README.md and launch-attestation.json for preparation, responsibilities and build evidence.
